concerns.text: T021 implements Yeo 7-network atlas extraction. However, Plan.md and Constitution Principle VI explicitly mandate the AAL atlas for DMN extraction. The task does not cover the required AAL implementation, leaving FR-003 (as interpreted by the Plan/Constitution) unimplemented.
T015 (Motion exclusion filter) is marked as unchecked/missing. This leaves FR-006 and SC-004 (motion exclusion >3mm/3°) without an implementing task, blocking the core data quality requirement.

T013 (fMRIPrep Docker runner) and T016 (Nilearn fallback) are marked as rejected/missing. This leaves FR-002 (preprocessing pipeline) and the Plan's compute feasibility strategy without executable tasks.

T012a (metadata schema) and T012b (design verification) are missing. This leaves FR-008 (dataset-variable fit verification) and FR-011 (design verification) without the necessary schema and logic tasks to function, rendering T018 incomplete.

T050 enforces strict real-data loading with NO synthetic fallback. This contradicts the Plan's 'Dataset Scarcity Contingency' which allows proceeding with 'any available resting-state dataset' if mindfulness datasets are scarce. The task blocks the plan's fallback mechanism, risking pipeline failure.

T021 includes a note stating 'If AAL atlas is desired, a separate spec revision process must update FR-003'. This indicates the task author recognizes the conflict with the Plan/Constitution but has not provided a task to implement the AAL requirement, leaving the requirement unmet in the current plan.
